headline: Ross Smith beats Searle 8-3 to win International Darts Open
standfirst: Ross Smith won European Tour 7 with an 8-3 final win over Ryan Searle, after a 7-0 whitewash of Cameron Menzies in the semi-finals.
body: Ross Smith won the International Darts Open, European Tour event seven, beating Ryan Searle 8-3 in the final at the WT Energiesysteme Arena in Riesa. It was a tight game on the scoreboard, with Smith averaging 90.81 to Searle's 90.11, but Smith took his chances on the doubles.

Smith's best display came in the semi-finals, where he whitewashed Cameron Menzies 7-0 with a 97.42 average. Earlier he beat Joe Cullen 6-3 with a 102.17 average, Ricardo Pietreczko 6-4 and Michael van Gerwen 6-5 in a deciding leg in the quarter-finals.

Searle reached the final the hard way. He beat Gian van Veen 6-3 in the quarter-finals with a 98.86 average, then edged Rob Cross 7-6 in the semi-finals. Cross averaged 100.10 in defeat and hit a 170 checkout during the match, the best finish of the weekend.
Kim Huybrechts posted the highest average of the event, 104.66, against Chris Dobey in the last 32. Gian van Veen hit 103.51 against Kevin Doets in the last 16.
There were 211 maximums across the tournament. Smith led the way with 14, ahead of Cross on 13 and Menzies on 12.
